stem: Event data retention has been set to 2 months for a year. Today the admin raises it to 14 months, and an analyst asks whether a funnel exploration over the past 12 months will now show the full year. What is the accurate answer?

options.text: Yes: raising retention restores the past 12 months to every exploration within 24 hours
Yes, but only in standard reports, which take their data from event data retention
No: explorations always cover at most 2 months of data, whatever the retention setting
No: older events were already deleted; only data still held is now kept for longer
